column1: # Phase 5d reviewed repackaging of the shipped ADempiere server library.
# The functional /webui-modern WAR takes its third-party runtime from the
# (setupSLib, line 355) builds by merging CSTools.jar, oracle.jar, driver.jar and
# CompiereJasperReqs.jar. Taking the runtime from the shipped server library
# rather than from a second, independently resolved dependency graph keeps
# /webui-modern on the same library versions the product ships.
# That archive holds 73,040 entries and roughly 276 MB uncompressed, most of it
# unreachable from the Phase 5d walking skeleton (Oracle JDBC, Groovy, Jython,
# Kotlin, icepdf, Telegram and Discord clients, the AWS SDK, ...). This file is
# therefore an allow-list, not a deny-list: `include` rows name the namespaces
# the slice actually needs, and `exclude` rows are applied on top of them.
# Both directions are verified. zkwebui `verifyPhase5dModernWebWar` re-checks
# every `exclude` row against the packaged bytes, and independently rejects any
# class that appears in more than one WEB-INF/lib jar or in both WEB-INF/lib and
# WEB-INF/classes, so an include row that reaches too far fails the same gate.

column3: Legacy servlet namespace. AdempiereSLib.jar carries 25 javax.servlet.jsp.jstl entries from CSTools.jar. Jakarta EE 10 owns jakarta.servlet, the container provides it, and no Phase 5d route is a JSP or JSTL page.
The JSTL implementation behind the javax.servlet.jsp.jstl API excluded above.
ZK CE 10 resolves commons-io:commons-io:2.19.0 through zk and zhtml.
ZK CE 10 uses org.apache.commons:commons-fileupload2-jakarta-servlet5. The Servlet 2.x-era commons-fileupload in the server library links against javax.servlet.
ZK CE 10 resolves org.apache-extras.beanshell:bsh:2.0b6 for its own zscript engine. Two BeanShell implementations in one classloader is a silent behaviour change.
ZK CE 10 resolves org.javassist:javassist:3.29.2-GA through zel.
ZK CE 10 resolves org.slf4j:slf4j-api:2.0.7. Two SLF4J APIs in one classloader is the classic "multiple bindings" failure.
ZK CE 10 resolves com.google.guava:guava:33.4.8-jre.
Any org.zkoss class inside the shipped server library is a ZK 3.6 artifact. The ZK runtime for this WAR is the locked ZK CE 10.3.0.1-jakarta closure only.
ZK 3.x add-on namespace. gradle/phase5/zk-compile-closure.gradle already bans it in source; it must not reappear as bytecode.
Test sources that leaked into an upstream third-party jar. Tests are never packaged.

JasperReports' own javax.servlet export servlets. They link against the legacy servlet namespace and no Phase 5d route reaches them; report export goes through org.compiere.jr.report.ReportStarter instead.

The Phase 5d route runs no report; org.compiere.jr.report.ReportStarter renders through the file/viewer path instead. Residual R4-5d-1: Phase 5g owns report parity and must decide whether the interactive viewer is migrated or dropped.
The PhantomJS bridge for JasperReports chart rendering, whose ServletContextListener links against javax.servlet. PhantomJS is an abandoned project and no Phase 5d route reaches it.
The single javax.servlet-linked class in Barbecue. The barcode renderer itself is included; only its optional servlet front end is removed.
